text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer! It's good to see you again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fine. I just went to visit a relative.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I went to my aunt's house. We<n>caught up and
talked a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you your souvenir later. Since<n>you help me
out a lot, it was only<n>polite to get you something...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We made cookies together<n>too. I'll give
some to you later.
